chinese_fishing_nets.name: Chinese Fishing Nets (Cheena Vala)
chinese_fishing_nets.description: Iconic 14th-century cantilevered fishing nets gifted by Chinese explorer Zheng He's court, silhouetted gracefully against Arabian Sea sunsets.

mattancherry_palace.name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
mattancherry_palace.description: Historic palace gifted by the Portuguese in 1555 and renovated by the Dutch, internationally famed for magnificent Hindu murals illustrating the Ramayana.

paradesi_synagogue.name: Paradesi Synagogue (Jew Town)
paradesi_synagogue.description: Oldest active synagogue in the Commonwealth built in 1568, featuring hand-painted 18th-century blue-willow Chinese porcelain tiles and Belgian chandeliers.

santa_cruz_basilica.name: Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica
santa_cruz_basilica.description: One of India's eight basilicas built in 1505 by Portuguese viceroy Francisco de Almeida, distinguished by twin whitewashed spires and Italian-style passion frescoes.

st_francis_church_kochi.name: St. Francis Church (Vasco da Gama Tomb)
st_francis_church_kochi.description: The oldest European-built church in India (1503), revered as the original resting place of Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama before his remains were moved to Lisbon.

fort_kochi_beach.name: Fort Kochi Beach & Coastal Promenade
fort_kochi_beach.description: Tranquil historical beachfront along the Arabian Sea shipping lane, lined with colonial rain trees, granite walkways, and the annual Cochin Carnival grounds.

marine_drive_kochi.name: Marine Drive Kochi & Rainbow Bridge
marine_drive_kochi.description: Picturesque pedestrian boulevard along the Vembanad backwaters in Ernakulam, famous for the arched Rainbow Bridge, Chinese Net Bridge, and sunset speedboating.

hill_palace_museum.name: Hill Palace Museum (Tripunithura)
hill_palace_museum.description: Kerala's largest archaeological palace complex built in 1865 across 54 acres, displaying the diamond-encrusted gold crown of Kochi Maharajas and antique palanquins.

bolgatty_palace.name: Bolgatty Palace & Island Resort
bolgatty_palace.description: Historic 1744 Dutch manor set on picturesque Bolgatty Island in the Kochi estuary, surrounded by a 9-hole golf course and international yacht marina.

mangalavanam_bird_sanctuary.name: Mangalavanam Bird Sanctuary (Green Lung)
mangalavanam_bird_sanctuary.description: Ecologically sensitive mangrove wetland in the heart of Kochi behind the High Court, providing refuge for breeding waterbirds and large flying fox bat colonies.

cherai_beach.name: Cherai Beach & Backwaters (Vypin)
cherai_beach.description: Stunning 10-km pristine coastline at the northern tip of Vypin Island where calm Arabian Sea surf borders serene palm-fringed backwaters, often visited by dolphins.

kerala_folklore_museum.name: Kerala Folklore Museum (Thevara)
kerala_folklore_museum.description: Architectural treasure house built over 25 years using salvaged heritage wood, preserving 4,000+ folk artifacts, Theyyam masks, musical instruments, and traditional theatre.

kerala_kathakali_centre.name: Kerala Kathakali Centre (Fort Kochi)
kerala_kathakali_centre.description: Premier cultural auditorium where spectators can witness elaborate facial makeup application followed by authentic classical Kathakali and martial Kalaripayattu recitals.

indo_portuguese_museum.name: Indo-Portuguese Museum
indo_portuguese_museum.description: Museum housed within the Bishop's House compound showcasing the rich artistic and religious synthesis between Portuguese craftsmanship and Kerala artisans.

willingdon_island.name: Willingdon Island
willingdon_island.description: India's largest artificial island engineered in 1936 by Sir Robert Bristow from port dredging soil, headquarters of the Cochin Port Trust and Southern Naval Command.

subhash_bose_park.name: Subhash Bose Park (Marine Promenade)
subhash_bose_park.description: Expansive 11-acre harbor-front public park next to the Ernakulam boat jetty, filled with shady trees, modern sculptures, and peaceful Vembanad Lake panoramas.

chottanikkara_temple.name: Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple
chottanikkara_temple.description: Famous Hindu pilgrimage where Mother Goddess is worshipped in three forms daily (Saraswati at dawn, Lakshmi at noon, Durga at night), renowned for Keezhkavu Guruthi rites.
chottanikkara_temple.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or late evening Guruthi puja

thrikkakara_temple.name: Thrikkakara Vamana Moorthy Temple (Birthplace of Onam)
thrikkakara_temple.description: The only ancient temple dedicated to Lord Vamana (Vishnu's 5th avatar) and King Mahabali, celebrated historically as the birthplace and epicentre of the Onam festival.

ernakulam_shiva_temple.name: Ernakulathappan Shiva Temple
ernakulam_shiva_temple.description: Centuries-old presiding deity temple of Ernakulam city situated in Durbar Hall grounds, constructed in classic Kerala circular sanctum style facing the sea.

vallarpadam_basilica.name: National Shrine Basilica of Our Lady of Ransom (Vallarpadam)
vallarpadam_basilica.description: Major Catholic national shrine on Vallarpadam Island founded in 1524, venerating Mother Mary credited with miraculously saving a mother and child from drowning.

lulu_mall_kochi.name: LuLu International Shopping Mall (Edapally)
lulu_mall_kochi.description: Pioneering 17-acre mega mall directly linked to Edapally Metro Station, featuring 300+ international outlets, South India's largest ice-skating rink, and 9-screen PVR.

kumbalangi_tourism_village.name: Kumbalangi Model Tourism Village
kumbalangi_tourism_village.description: India's first designated eco-tourism village on island backwaters, offering authentic crab farming tours, traditional coir making, and quiet country-boat rides.
kumbalangi_tourism_village.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Late afternoon sunset boat ride)

vypeen_lighthouse.name: Vypeen Lighthouse & Puthuvype Beach
vypeen_lighthouse.description: Towering 46-meter coastal lighthouse built in 1979 on Puthuvype beach; ascending by elevator delivers a sensational 360-degree vista of Kochi harbour.

jawaharlal_nehru_stadium_kochi.name: Jawaharlal Nehru International Stadium (Kaloor)
jawaharlal_nehru_stadium_kochi.description: Iconic 60,000-capacity multi-purpose arena, home of Kerala Blasters FC in the Indian Super League (ISL), turning into a passionate 'Yellow Sea' on match nights.
jawaharlal_nehru_stadium_kochi.best_time_to_visit: ISL football match nights (Directly at JLN Stadium Metro)

dutch_cemetery_kochi.name: Dutch Cemetery Fort Kochi
dutch_cemetery_kochi.description: Consecrated in 1724, this shaded colonial burial ground holds 104 authentic tombs and epitaphs of Dutch East India Company officers and their families.

bastion_bungalow.name: Bastion Bungalow & District Heritage Museum
bastion_bungalow.description: 1667 Dutch manor built atop the Stromberg Bastion of ancient Portuguese Fort Immanuel, now functioning as a rich multi-media maritime heritage museum.

kuzhupilly_beach.name: Kuzhupilly Beach & Prawn Farms
kuzhupilly_beach.description: Serene lesser-known white sand beach on Vypin approach, bordered by paddy fields, extensive prawn hatcheries, and whispering coastal casuarina groves.

edappally_church.name: St. George Syro-Malabar Forane Church (Edappally)
edappally_church.description: Founded in 593 CE, one of Asia's largest and oldest pilgrimage shrines dedicated to Saint George, drawing millions of multi-faith pilgrims offering golden roosters.

kadamakkudy_islands.name: Kadamakkudy Backwater Islands
kadamakkudy_islands.description: A picturesque archipelago of 14 backwater islets famous for organic Pokkali saltwater rice cultivation, migratory birds, water lilies, and rustic wooden walkways.

aluva_manappuram.name: Aluva Manappuram & Periyar River Temple
aluva_manappuram.description: Sacred sandy riverbank temple on the Periyar River where the Shiva lingam is naturally submerged during monsoon; epicentre of Kerala's grand Aluva Sivarathri festival.
aluva_manappuram.best_time_to_visit: Mahashivratri or morning visit (Close to Aluva Metro)

sree_poornathrayeesa_temple.name: Sree Poornathrayeesa Temple (Tripunithura)
sree_poornathrayeesa_temple.description: Ancient tutelary deity temple of the Cochin Royal Family dedicated to Lord Santhanagopala Murthy (Vishnu), celebrated for the grand Vrishchika Ulsavam elephant pageant.

centre_square_mall.name: Centre Square Mall (MG Road)
centre_square_mall.description: Premier central downtown lifestyle mall located right on MG Road near the metro, featuring major fashion department stores and Cinepolis multiplex.

kochi_muziris_biennale.name: Aspinwall House (Kochi-Muziris Biennale)
kochi_muziris_biennale.description: Primary sea-facing heritage warehouse venue of Asia's largest contemporary art festival (Kochi-Muziris Biennale), displaying groundbreaking global installations.
kochi_muziris_biennale.best_time_to_visit: December to April during Biennale editions

pallippuram_fort.name: Pallippuram Fort (Ayikkotta)
pallippuram_fort.description: Built in 1503 by the Portuguese, this hexagonal stone stronghold is the oldest surviving European-built fort in India, standing quietly near Munambam.

wonderla_kochi.name: Wonderla Amusement Park (Kochi)
wonderla_kochi.description: Premier world-class amusement and water theme park at Pallikkara featuring 50+ thrill rides, solar-heated pools, high-speed roller coasters, and 3D virtual shows.

dharmanath_jain_temple.name: Shri Dharmanath Jain Derasar (Mattancherry)
dharmanath_jain_temple.description: Exquisite 100-year-old white marble Jain temple in Mattancherry with intricate Rajasthani-style carvings, sanctifying the 15th Tirthankara Dharmanath.
dharmanath_jain_temple.best_time_to_visit: Mornings or 12:00 noon pigeon feeding ceremony

broadway_ernakulam.name: Broadway Heritage Wholesale Market
broadway_ernakulam.description: Kochi's oldest bustling narrow shopping street in Ernakulam, packed with fragrant Malabar spice traders, umbrella merchants, and traditional brassware.

munambam_beach.name: Munambam Beach & Muziris Breakwater
munambam_beach.description: Dramatic coastal junction where the Periyar River meets the Arabian Sea, featuring a walkable granite breakwater pathway and a buzzing deep-sea fishing port.

goshree_bridges.name: Goshree Island Bridges Causeway
goshree_bridges.description: Trio of bridges linking mainland Ernakulam to Bolgatty, Vallarpadam, and Vypeen islands, celebrated for breezy night drives over backwater estuaries.

kothad_island.name: Kothad Island & Backwaters
kothad_island.description: Tranquil green backwater island reachable by bridge, beloved for scenic country road cycling, water lilies, and the Sacred Heart Church waterfront.

andhakaranazhi_beach.name: Andhakaranazhi Beach & Spillway Bridge
andhakaranazhi_beach.description: Picturesque coastal lagoon and beach south of Kochi where backwater floodgates open to the sea, featuring an elevated observation walkway and sunset lighthouse.

ernakulam_public_library.name: Ernakulam Public Library Heritage Building
ernakulam_public_library.description: Established in 1870, this colonial library building opposite Durbar Hall features antique teak staircases, high ceilings, and rare Malayalam historical manuscripts.

marina_kochi_yacht_club.name: Kochi International Marina
marina_kochi_yacht_club.description: India's sole full-fledged international marina situated at Bolgatty Island, berthing global yachts and sailing vessels with 34 floating berths.

malayattoor_church.name: St. Thomas Church Kurisumudy (Malayattoor)
malayattoor_church.description: International hilltop pilgrimage shrine at Kurisumudy (609m) dedicated to Apostle St. Thomas who prayed here in 52 CE, blessed with sacred footprints on rock.

cochin_port_maritime_heritage_museum.name: Cochin Port Maritime Heritage Museum
cochin_port_maritime_heritage_museum.description: Housed in historic Bristow House on Willingdon Island, chronicling the engineering genius of Robert Bristow who birthed modern Cochin Port with rare photos and maritime gear.

tripunithura_kalikotta_palace.name: Kalikotta Palace (Tripunithura)
tripunithura_kalikotta_palace.description: Historic performance auditorium palace built by Kochi Maharaja Rama Varma for traditional arts, Kathakali recitals, and royal assemblies.

cochin_shipyard.name: Cochin Shipyard (Birthplace of INS Vikrant)
cochin_shipyard.description: India's largest shipbuilding and maintenance facility spanning MG Road South, prestigious builder of India's first indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant.

palarivattom_st_martin.name: St. Martin de Porres Church (Palarivattom)
palarivattom_st_martin.description: Prominent modern church situated near Palarivattom Metro station, known for its soaring bell tower and peaceful prayer nave.

changampuzha_park.name: Changampuzha Park (Edappally)
changampuzha_park.description: Cultural hub and green memorial park honoring celebrated Malayalam poet Changampuzha Krishna Pillai, hosting daily evening Kathakali and classical recitals.

rainbow_bridge_kochi.name: Rainbow Hanging Bridge (Marine Drive)
rainbow_bridge_kochi.description: Graceful arch suspension pedestrian footbridge over the backwaters of Marine Drive, spectacularly illuminated in radiant rainbow hues at night.
